notes.title: ENCODYA Update v1.1 (language update) has been released!
notes.notes:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, and your valuable feedback for sure, we have released another update for ENCODYA. This time adding three localizations! 

[h1]Three new languages added[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Added Simplified Chinese localization[/b]
[*] [b]Added Japanese localization[/b]
[*] [b]Added Korean localization[/b][/list]

[h3]Improvemnets & Tweaks[/h3]
[list][*] Improved some of the German localization
[*] Reduced size and opacity of the FPS counter
[*] Removed from Inventory some items when going back to reality in the epilogue[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed few bugs with the Missions Tracker interface
[*] Fixed few bugs when loading on certain locations
[*] Fixed a bug with Traffic Bot about Police Permission if starting the quest with Tina and finishing it with Sam and viceversa
[*] Polished few bugs related with hotspots[/list]

notes.title: Small Bugfix update for ENCODYA has been released (v.1.09)
notes.notes:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, and your valuable feedback for sure, we have released another small bugfix update for ENCODYA today!

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the font size for the Missions Tracker.
[*] Improved German localization.
[*] Fixed a bug related with VSync being turned off when changing quality.
[*] Fixed a small bug with Gia saying "Uh?" at diner even when not there.
[*] Fixed a dialogue option that now allows Tina to ask Eku for a fuse.
[*] Fixed a dialogue option that now allows Sam to ask Arcade for the spray can.[/list]

notes.title: ENCODYA Update v1.08 has been released!
notes.notes:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, and your valuable feedback for sure, we have released another small update for ENCODYA.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the bug (known issue) that made the cursor disappear, after using load/continue on some locations 
[*] Fixed some visual glitches with Russian font.
[*] Fixed a bug that restored the Highlight Circles on Load.
[*] Fixed a bug with Missing Database persons overlapping 
[*] Moved a collectable item a bit, to be more noticeable.
[*] Fixed a wrong interaction with the Shelter after returning to it.[/list]

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list][*] Added more people walking around the streets 
[*] Improved Russian translation 
[*] Adjusted a few names in the credits[/list]

[h3]Known Issues v1.08:[/h3]
[list][*] Currently the font size of the the Missions Tracker (small menu activated with the yellow "!" icon top right corner) is increased. Due to this, in Italian and German, the text of some Missions is cut, if the text is too long.[/list]

notes.title: ENCODYA - First small update released!
notes.notes:
Cyberpunk-Fans! 
Thanks to the technology of 2062, we can release the first small update this quickly. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a bug about Blixy: 'Look At' and 'Pick' interactions are now disabled after getting the keys.
[*]Fixed a bug about 'Traffic Bot' giving you twice the 'Police Permission'.
[*]Fixed a bug about reactivating the UI when quitting the very last Terminal.
[*]Fixed a small bug, which caused the Russian font not displaying buttons in the Main Menu.
[*]Fixed a small bug on the 'Total Game Played' at the very end.[/list]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]
[list][*]Disabled Mac Retina Support that might cause slow performance on Mac.[/list]


[h1]Thank you for your ongoing support for ENCODYA![/h1]

notes.title: ENCODYA - Release Date and new Gameplay-Trailer revealed!
notes.notes:
Together with developer [i][b]Chaosmonger Studio[/b][/i] we are delighted to share today a [b]new trailer[/b] and an [b]official release date[/b] for the upcoming dystopian point-and-click adventure game [b]ENCODYA[/b]. 

[b]On January 26, 2021, ENCODYA will make its debut on Windows PC, Mac, and Linux[/b] here on Steam. 
Following a nine-year-old orphan and her clumsy robot guardian and set in the year 2062, [i][b]ENCODYA[/b][/i] is a dark yet heartwarming tale of love, perseverance, and greed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/fb7aba80d2588a026a65ac18ccbdbab8cabc8c64.gif[/img]

[i][b]ENCODYA[/b][/i] puts you in the role of [i]Tina[/i], an orphan with nothing to call her own. Her guardian, a large and lumbering robot named [i]SAM-53[/i], is her only safety and protection from a grim world full of greed and brutal poverty. Controlled by tyrannical corporations, [i]Tina[/i] and [i]SAM-53[/i] must make the best of their circumstances in order to set out on an adventure to turn their cyberpunk dystopia into a lively utopia once more. Without knowing what danger lurks behind the next corner, [i]Tina[/i] will rely on her wit and [i]SAM-53[/i]’s metal muscle to leave a life of homelessness and scavenging behind her. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669041/6787498da326c8484042133ddea429397402c69c.gif[/img]

[h3]Watch the new ENCODYA gameplay trailer here: [/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P7CbC1ABjLM


[h3]About ENCODYA[/h3]
Based on the animated short called “Robot Will Protect You,” and inspired by the atmosphere of Blade Runner and the poignant storytelling of Studio Ghibli, Encodya features a distinctive art style and deep, immersive sound design. The original soundtrack creates a thrilling atmosphere to explore the menacing world of Neo-Berlin in 2.5D with the two playable characters, Tina and SAM-53. With more than 35 NPCs to bring the story to life and over 4,000 lines of dialogue, Encodya offers a beautifully grim adventure that gracefully nods to the real-world atrocities of our current society. 

[h3]Features of ENCODYA: [/h3]
[list][*] Explore the dark cyberpunk world of ENCODYA in 2.5D with 2 playable characters.
[*] Over 34+ non-player characters bring the world and story of ENCODYA to life.
[*] More than 100 locations to discover and explore.
[*] Over 4000+ lines of dialogue tell an immersive story.
[*] Randomization of some puzzles for a unique experience.
[*] Cinematic Cut Scenes.
[*] Amazing art and sound design. 
[*] The original soundtrack creates a thrilling atmosphere.
[*] Professional dubbing actors lend their voices to the characters.
[*] Lots of Easter Eggs and 10 Secrets to find.[/list]

[h3]More about ENCODYA[/h3]
